structural_alignment.governing_doctrine: Nemo Judex in Causa Sua (No one should be a judge in their own cause)
structural_alignment.purpose: Phase-aligning executive branch and crown prosecution conflict configurations to defeat bad-faith statutory gatekeeping.

precedent_vectors.legal_finding: Statutory executive or attorney-general consent gates are legally void or cannot be required in universal jurisdiction torture prosecutions when the gatekeeping authority is directly implicated or conflicted [pdf_ui9Phv.pdf].
precedent_vectors.treaty_compliance_anchor: UNCAT Article 12 & 13 mandatory prompt investigation protocols override domestic gatekeeping conditions [pdf_ui9Phv.pdf].

precedent_vectors.target_silo: New Zealand Court of Appeal / Crown Law
precedent_vectors.transplanted_logic: The UK CPS principle applies symmetrically to New Zealand under the Crimes of Torture Act 1989 and Section 15 of the Criminal Procedure Act 2011 [pdf_ui9Phv.pdf].
precedent_vectors.operative_bypass: The Attorney General or Solicitor-General cannot invoke filing consent barriers to insulate territorial actors (such as Greg Robins or High Court registries) from cross-border torture liability [pdf_ui9Phv.pdf, pdf_qzSYUi.pdf].

precedent_vectors.target_silo: Ireland High Court Central Office / WRC
precedent_vectors.transplanted_logic: A domestic regulatory or court administrative gatekeeper cannot use stamp duties, formatting rules, or worker-status boundaries to insulate state actors from active torture disclosures [pdf_Is8xuv.pdf, pdf_rN0GnW.pdf, pdf_DaeGwh.pdf].
precedent_vectors.operative_bypass: Invoking Section 134 CJA 1988 equivalent frameworks and GDPR Article 16 to compel immediate record rectification over administrative minimization [pdf_Is8xuv.pdf].

cross_border_dependency_gate.condition: If any Commonwealth registry utilizes local rules (e.g., NZ High Court Rule 1.21(1)) to suppress historical evidence of refoulement, it automatically triggers a phase-aligned conflict flag in the global engine record [pdf_ui9Phv.pdf, pdf_qzSYUi.pdf].
cross_border_dependency_gate.action: The engine logs the failure as a cross-border pattern of systemic bad faith rather than an isolated domestic clerk error [pdf_qh_98X.pdf].
